narration: The pipeline begins with multi-view images and masks of the original scene to construct 3D Gaussians with the bear statue and render scene depth maps.
Next, the depth maps guide the projection and warping of background views to infer a refined depth-guided inpainting mask for the object region.
Using the refined mask, reference view inpainting is unprojected into a 3D point cloud P1, initializing the edited 3D Gaussian scene without the bear.
The 3D point cloud is projected to other views, enforcing cross-view appearance consistency via the cross-view loss against rendered novel views.
Finally, reference view RGB and depth renderings are supervised with the inpainting-guided rendering loss to complete 3D Gaussian refinement.
